projects.annotation_type: Longitudinal Bounding Boxes & Polygons covering full yarn strands
projects.suitability_assessment: Unsuitable for direct thread density counting: predicts uncalibrated box counts in 640x640 space without spatial scale. Suffer from NMS suppression on dense yarns.

projects.annotation_type: Fine multi-point polygon masks on exposed yarn float points + bounding box on physical ruler (measure)
projects.suitability_assessment: Partially suitable for float-point localization and scale detection, but low mIoU (35.7%) causes severe float fragmentation, necessitating heuristic graph tracking.

empirical_nms_simulation.nms_vulnerability_summary: In dense fabric geometries, adjacent parallel yarns yield bounding box overlap that triggers NMS suppression at standard thresholds (0.45-0.50), causing 30-50% undercounting unless NMS is disabled.

benchmark_swatch_comparison.bounding_box_vulnerability: High (Parallel longitudinal boxes suppress adjacent threads under IoU >= 0.40)
High (Parallel longitudinal boxes suppress adjacent threads under IoU >= 0.40)

conclusions.direct_box_counting_feasibility: Fails: lacks metric calibration ($S_x, S_y$) and suffers from severe NMS suppression on parallel strands.
conclusions.segmentation_mask_feasibility: Viable ONLY when coupled with geometric tracking / skeletonization and metric calibration ($S_x, S_y$).
